text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is a special day—it's the day Hishi
Amazon
and I will start taking on the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Let's go! It's you and me, baby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Hishi Amazon is engaged in a
one-on-one.

text_block_list.name: Miho Student
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Hishiama's as amazing as ever!
Knock 'em
down!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Student
text_block_list.text: Nah, our dorm leader is gonna be on top! Look, she snapped up the lead, just like that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both racers fly down the homestretch after
rounding the fourth corner. Fuji
Kiseki pushes forward, completely
composed. She's got a grip on the lead,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon scoffs.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna looooose!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you're not getting past me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon is ablaze with passion as
she flies
down the track and quickly
closes in on Fuji
Kiseki...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two sprint for the finish line in
unison amid
roaring cheers from the
audience.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Graaah! I smashed my way through!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You've gotten really good. That race
sent tingles
down my spine.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. My debut is right around the
corner, so I
put in my all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But you were on fire today too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Consider this your parting gift.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Aim high in the Twinkle Series—and
never settle
for second, Hishiama.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You're a good one, Fuji! You really are!

text_block_list.name: Underclassmen
text_block_list.text:
Squeee! Even their conversations are
intense!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Squeee?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon looks up and is startled by
the
crowd of younger students waving at
her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Where did they come from?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming! I hope you all
enjoyed my
spectacular send-off race for
Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hang on a sec! Did you just make this
your
parting gift to me 'cause there's an
audience
watchin' us?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, get your arm from around my
shoulders, and quit tryin' to look all
buddy-buddy! And stop
waving at 'em!
You're not fooling me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The younger students' enthusiastic
cheering
echoes under the blue sky long
after the race.

text_block_list.name: Ritto Student
text_block_list.text:
Wow, what an intense race. I learned a
lot after
watching it.

text_block_list.name: Miho Student
text_block_list.text:
Well, our Hishiama pours her heart and
soul into
every one-on-one she runs, so
of course it was
intense!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Student
text_block_list.text:
I've been wondering about this for a
while, but
why does Hishiama like to
compete so much
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Miho Student
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... If I remember correctly, it's
because...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overhearing their conversation, I
remember what
Hishi Amazon said when
I asked her that myself...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I guess I get it from my mom.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She ran in races all over the world, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I really look up to her, and she's the
reason why I
got interested in racing too!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Student
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that makes sense. With a mom like
that,
anyone'd wanna be a racer.

text_block_list.name: Miho Student
text_block_list.text:
But Hishiama doesn't just do normal
races, she's
all about the one-on-ones!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Student
text_block_list.text:
...But what makes them one-on-ones,
specifically?

text_block_list.name: Miho Student
text_block_list.text: Well that's because... Wait, why are they called one-on-ones?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've never given it much thought, but I
wonder
why Hishi Amazon likes to call
races
"one-on-ones"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make a mental note to ask her later,
but it turns
out I don't have to.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to make you tag along to my
training sesh,
Teach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch Hishi Amazon while she does her
stretches
by the river, but suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Bono and Biko
text_block_list.text: Nnngh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus, a hero-loving Umamusume, and
Hishi Akebono, an
Umamusume big in both heart
and body,
run full speed under the overpass.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh. They're havin' a one-on-one under
the
overpass, eh? Now that takes me
back.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, when I was young, I duked it out
with
someone under an underpass like
this one.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I think it started over a silly turf
war. I
challenged
some big shot kid from the
next town over.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...You know, that might have been my
first ever
one-on-one.

text_block_list.name: Bono and Biko
text_block_list.text:
Full throttle all the waaay!
I'm gonna be
the one to win this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus is right behind Hishi
Akebono. The
two are neck-and-neck,
and I can't look away.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Those two remind me of her. She was a
great
runner who radiated passion.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I knew goin' into the challenge that it'd
be intense, but running with her myself, 
side-by-side—it was more than I could've

imagined.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the sun sets and turns everything
gold, the two hurtle toward their goal
along the riverbank,
almost colliding
into each other.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
As a kid, I was shocked to realize
something so
fun existed.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Woo-hoo! It's my win today! I beat you,
Bono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... I can't believe you caught up with me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Gosh, you've gotten even faster, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two continue their friendly
conversation
under the overpass.
They've yet to notice us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tackling competition head-on and
letting her
passion burn—that's what a
one-on-one means to
Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm slowly starting to understand why she
thinks
about races in the same way.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can't wait for the Twinkle
Series!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I get tingles just imagining the
one-on-ones I'll be
gettin' up to!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You'd better keep it up and continue
supportin'
me throughout it, all right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Hey, you two, you better
give it a rest
soon! It looks like it's about
to rain, and you wouldn't want to catch a
cold out here!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's, Hishiama! Can't we run just a
little bit
more?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we just wanna race a little longer!

Pleeease?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll whip up my special carrot steak for
you if you
go back now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: No way! You will? Yippee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two rush off home to the dorm. Hishi
Amazon
watches them go with a gentle
look in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Those two sure are a handful...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begins my journey through the
Twinkle Series with Hishi Amazon, who's
passionate,
dynamic, and a little
motherly too.
